title: Pit board plate
question: Lock one empty plate. That art becomes the PNG. Re-roll deals three other structures.

options.label: Flag Tab
options.thesis: One orange tab on the top-left carries the mark. The rest of the plate is an open white field.
options.viewport: Wide rounded plate. Small orange tab at the top-left with the logo and HOLESHOT. Thin black rim. Handle slots in the upper corners. Empty white center.
options.risk: The tab reads as a sticker if it does not share the plate edge.

options.label: Chevron Frame
options.thesis: Two orange chevrons point in from the sides and stop before the empty center.
options.viewport: Wide plate. Chevrons only in the outer sides. HOLESHOT and the logo sit small on the bottom edge. Handle slots up top. The middle stays white.
options.risk: The chevrons crowd the lap time if they reach past the outer fifth.

options.label: Stepped Crown
options.thesis: The top center steps up into a short orange crown that holds HOLESHOT. Under it, a plain white well.
options.viewport: Stepped silhouette. Orange crown on top with the logo and HOLESHOT. Handle slots in the side shoulders. A black hairline around the white well. Plain bottom.
options.risk: A tall crown steals the top of the field where the name sits.
